verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Fathom publishes an llms.txt at developers.fathom.ai/llms.txt. It returns HTTP 200 and indexes the developer docs as markdown (.md) pages that an agent can ingest directly, which delivers the core of the story. missing for 10: evidence of a fuller agent bundle (e.g., llms-full.txt) or first-party docs describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.fathom.ai/llms.txt # Fathom API
